verdict.rationale: Factory supports delegating scoped tasks to Custom Droids, one-shot droid exec for CI/CD/batch processing, an API for creating/managing multiple Droid sessions, and Missions for orchestrating large multi-feature work—these collectively suggest concurrency support for engineering leads. However, there is no explicit documentation or evidence of dashboards, concurrency limits, or UI specifically designed for monitoring/managing many parallel agent tasks at scale.
